blocks.text: Vertebrae ke beech intervertebral discs (gaddiyan) jhatka jazb karne wale (shock absorbers) ka kaam karti hain aur harkat mein madad deti hain. Herniated ya slipped disc tab hoti hai jab disc ki bahar wali tah phat jaye; is se andar ka gel jaisa maadda bahar nikal kar qareeb ki nerves ya spinal cord ko dabata hai. Is ki wajah chot (trauma), barhti umar ke saath ghisao (degeneration), ya reerh ki haddi par baar baar zor parna ho sakti hai. Alamaat (symptoms): mutasira jagah par dard, sunn hona aur jhunjhunahat, muscles ki kamzori ya un ka kaam chhor dena, aur shadeed halat mein pakhane ya peshab par control khatam hona.

blocks.alt: Baen: kamar ka nichla hissa peechhe se, reerh ki haddi ke saath; ek box aur surkh dhabba lumbar vertebrae dikhate hain. Daen: box ka bara manzar do vertebrae aur un ke beech disc dikhata hai jis ka andaruni maadda peechhe ko ubhar kar herniated disc banata hai aur peechhe chalti nerve ko daba deta hai. Labels: Lumbar vertebrae, Vertebra, Herniated disc, Pressed nerve.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.11: Disc slip (herniation) (kitab ki Figure 12.11 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Disc ka bahari khol phatne par andar ka narm maadda (surkh) bahar nikal kar nerve par dabao dalta hai; isi liye dard aur sunn-pan hota hai. Aksar yeh kamar ke lumbar hisse mein hota hai jahan wazan sab se zyada hai.

Spondylosis ka matlab hai reerh ki haddi ke vertebrae, intervertebral discs, ligaments ya cartilage ka ghis jana (degeneration). Is se intervertebral disc patli ho kar jur sakti hai aur haddi par ubhar (bone outgrowths) ban sakte hain. Yeh nerves ya spinal cord ko dabate hain. Spondylosis zyada tar kamar ke nichle hisse (lumbar vertebrae) aur gardan (cervical vertebrae) mein hoti hai. Sab se aam wajah intervertebral discs ka qudrati taur par ghisna hai. Yeh barhti umar, khandani (genetic) asar, chot, der tak ghalat posture aur motape se hoti hai. Alamaat: kamar ya gardan ka dard, akran (stiffness) aur harkat ka kam ho jana.

blocks.alt: Disc ke saath paanch vertebrae ke do pehlu ke manzar. Baen, Normal Vertebral column: vertebrae ke darmiyan barabar discs. Daen, Spondylosis: vertebrae ke kinaron par bone outgrowths, ek tang (narrowed) disc aur peechhe ko ubhri hui slipped disc.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.12: Spondylosis (kitab ki Figure 12.12 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Dono columns ka muqabla karein. Spondylosis mein umr ke saath discs ghis kar patli ho jati hain, haddi ke kinaron par kaante jaise bone outgrowths ugte hain, aur kabhi disc khisak jati hai. Yeh sab asaab par dabao dal kar dard aur akran paida karte hain.

Sciatica ka matlab hai sciatic nerve ka dabna ya us mein jalan (irritation) hona. Sciatic nerve kamar ke nichle hisse se shuru ho kar koolhon (buttocks) se hoti hui har taang mein neeche jati hai. Sciatica aksar herniated disc ya ubhri hui (bulging) disc ki wajah se hota hai jo sciatic nerve ko dabati hai. Doosri wajahen chot, infection, sozish (inflammation) aur spondylosis hain.

blocks.alt: Baen: jism ka nichla hissa peechhe se, nichli kamar se har taang mein jati sciatic nerve aur ek taang ke saath surkh dard ka ilaqa. Daen upar: lumbar reerh ka pehlu jahan herniated disc sciatic nerve ko dabati hai. Daen neeche: upar se dekha gaya vertebra jahan bulging disc nerve root par dabao dalti hai. Labels: Sciatic nerve, Area of pain, Herniated disc, Sciatic nerve compressed, Bulging disc.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.13: Sciatica aur us ki wajoohat (kitab ki Figure 12.13 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Alamaat: kamar ke nichle hisse, koolhon, taangon ya paon mein dard ya bechaini; taangon ya paon mein jhunjhunahat ya sunn hona; taangen ya paon hilane mein kamzori ya mushkil.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sciatic nerve jism ki sab se lambi nerve hai. Jab kamar mein disc us ki jar (root) ko dabati hai to dard kamar mein nahin balke poori taang ke saath neeche mehsoos hota hai, jaisa surkh ilaqa dikhata hai.

Arthritis mein woh mukhtalif bimariyan shamil hain jin mein joron mein sozish (inflammation) hoti hai. Har qism mein jor ka dard aur akran hota hai. Doosri alamaat mein mutasira jor ka laal hona, garam hona aur soojna shamil hain. Arthritis ki ahem qismein yeh hain:

blocks.alt: Teen panels. Osteoarthritis: ghutne ka jor jis ki articular cartilage patli aur tooti hui hai (degenerated cartilage). Rheumatoid arthritis: ghutne ka jor jis ki synovial membrane moti, surkh aur suji hui hai (inflammation in synovial membrane). Gouty arthritis: upar se paon jis ke angoothe ka jor surkh aur suja hua hai aur us mein suiyon jaise uric acid crystals hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.14: Arthritis ki qismein (kitab ki Figure 12.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.text: Osteoarthritis sab se aam qism hai. Is mein joron mein haddiyon ke siron par lagi articular cartilage aahista aahista naram ho kar toot jati hai. Yeh ghutne, koolhe aur reerh ke joron ko mutasir karti hai.

Rheumatoid arthritis ek autoimmune bimari ka nateeja hai (jism ka defence system apne hi tissue par hamla karta hai); is mein synovial membrane mein sozish ho jati hai. Zyada tar kalai aur haath mutasir hote hain.

Gouty arthritis (gout) tab hota hai jab khoon mein uric acid jama ho jata hai; yeh joron mein crystals bana kar sozish paida karta hai. Sab se zyada paon ke bare angoothe ka jor mutasir hota hai. Doosre jor (ghutne, kalaiyan aur ungliyan) bhi mutasir ho sakte hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Teenon mein jor mein dard hai magar wajah alag: osteoarthritis mein cartilage ghis jati hai, rheumatoid mein jism ka apna defence synovial membrane par hamla kar ke soozish karta hai, aur gout mein khoon ka uric acid crystals ban kar aksar paon ke angoothe ke jor mein jam jata hai.

Osteoporosis aisi halat hai jis mein haddiyan kamzor ho jati hain aur aasani se toot jati hain (fracture). Yeh tab hoti hai jab haddi ki kasafat (bone density, haddi kitni thos hai) kam ho jaye aur haddiyan nazuk aur surakhon wali (porous) ho jayen. Is ki wajahen:

blocks.alt: Reerh ke pehlu ke manzar mein nishan zada lumbar vertebra se liye gaye spongy bone ke do chokor namoone: normal haddi jis mein bohat se chhote khane hain, aur osteoporosis wali haddi jis mein kam magar kahin bare khane hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.15: Normal haddi aur osteoporosis (kitab ki Figure 12.15 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

items: Umar barhne ke saath haddi ki miqdar (bone mass) qudrati taur par kam hoti hai; kuch logon mein yeh kami zyada hoti hai.
Auraton mein menopause (haiz band hone) ke baad oestrogen hormone kam ho jata hai, jis se haddi tezi se ghatti hai.
Khurak mein calcium aur vitamin D ki kami haddi ki sehat bigarti hai. Calcium haddi ki mazbooti ke liye zaroori hai aur vitamin D jism ko calcium jazb karne mein madad deta hai.
Wazan uthane wali warzish (weight-bearing exercise) na karne se haddiyan kamzor ho sakti hain.
Kuch ilaj, maslan corticosteroids (dawaon) ka lamba istemal, haddi ko kam kar sakta hai.
Smoking aur sharab bhi osteoporosis ka khatra barhate hain.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Kitab yahan khurdbeen ki tasveer chhapti hai; yeh us ka saada khaaka hai. Osteoporosis mein haddi ki kasafat (density) kam hoti hai: khane bare aur deewarein patli, is liye haddi halki si chot par toot jati hai.
